Description
Unlike the Western calendar, each new year is celebrated based on the lunar cycle of time, which originated in China millennia ago. The
Chinese Lunar New Year
follows a 12-year cycle, with each year represented by a different animal and its unique characteristics.
Bullion Trading LLC
also sells the PAMP Suisse Year of the Tiger 5 Gram Gold Bar (in assay).
PAMP Suisse
created this 5
gram gold bar
to commemorate 2022 as the Chinese lunar calendar’s Year of the Tiger. This
Lunar Gold bar
exemplifies why PAMP has built a reputation for attractive, high-quality investments. As the third animal in the 12-year Chinese Zodiac cycle, this new 2022 Year of the Tiger bar joins the acclaimed
PAMP Lunar Series
. This eye-catching PAMP Suisse gold bar is constructed of .9999 pure gold and is sealed in a red
CertiPAMP assay
. For easy certification, the card has a unique serial number that matches the one found inscribed on the bar. Don’t put it off any longer; get your hands on the 5 Gram PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger Gold Bar as soon as possible!
PAMP Suisse’s Chinese Zodiac Series began in 2012 with the release of Year of the Dragon bars and has since continued with Year of the Tiger bars. People born under the promising sign of the tiger are lovely, lively, daring, and appealing. This zodiac’s most recent years include 1962, 1974, 1986, 1998, and 2010. This 5 Gram PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger Gold Bar will be an outstanding addition to any precious metal investor’s portfolio or would make an excellent gift for anyone born in the Year of the Tiger, so get yours today!
Design of 5 Gram PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger Gold Bar
Individual blister cards are available for all 5 Gram PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger Gold Bars. The protective blister cards seal the
gold bars
and the center and include a red assay card as part of the package. The assay has decorative embellishments on the front and the date and series information. The bar’s weight, purity, and metal content are listed on the opposite side of the assay card, together with the card’s unique serial number and the signature of a certified assayer.
The obverse field of the
PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger Gold Bar
depicts a tiger descending. The muscular tiger is represented in this artwork by climbing successfully down the trunk of a tree with its front legs bracing its body and its rear legs resting in the Y-branch of the tree trunk. This field contains the Chinese tiger emblem. Inscriptions, including the kanji for “Tiger,” can also be seen.
The mint uses a similar design element on the reverse side of the
5 Gram PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger Gold Bar
. This time, you view the tiger from behind as it descends the tree, its tail still dangling through the trunk’s Y-branch. This side features the mint logo and the identifying hallmarks and serial number.
Main Highlights of 5 Gram PAMP Suisse Lunar Tiger Gold Bar
Contains 5 Grams (.1607 Troy oz) of .9999 pure gold.
Produced by the
PAMP Suisse
refinery
Obverse: Depicts a majestic tiger descending from a tree. The Chinese kanji for Tiger, “虎”, also appears on this side right above the tree.
Reverse: This image depicts the tiger from behind. The fineness, weight, and serial number are also indicated.
The red assay card contains a serial number that matches the one on each Gold Year of the Tiger bar, ensuring the weight and purity of these PAMP Gold Bars.
